notes: Sampled-value convention: a change at edge E is seen at sample E+1, so checks use |=> / $past. CHK-007 uses counter lcnt_q (sampled value at A_L+k equals k, 32-bit so 17*255 fits). The "no change between edges" part of CHK-007 is not checked (no async sampling allowed). CHK-009 covers burst start only; Pause/joint handshakes are not checked.
